parents.motivation: v3 S7 was refuted because unordered accumulated occurrence history never eliminated more worlds than the final snapshot; v3.1 showed all four M settings collapse within each static A×B support class.

fixed_generator: Exactly the frozen independent stochastic BAM v3 generator, landscape, associates, candidate grid, six truth scenarios, 64 replicates and 40-step histories.

temporal_evidence_rule.observed: For every node observed by horizon h, retain its first stochastic occurrence step t_obs.
temporal_evidence_rule.candidate: For every candidate world, compute its earliest structurally possible arrival step t_min from the declared source using the EOG transition operator.
temporal_evidence_rule.compatibility: Candidate remains compatible when t_min <= t_obs for every observed node. Earlier candidate arrival is allowed because stochastic colonisation can be delayed; later candidate arrival than observed is impossible.

hypotheses.claim: The frozen truth world is retained in every eligible replicate/horizon under the one-sided earliest-arrival rule.
Time-stamped positive evidence can only contract or preserve the compatible set obtained from the same unordered accumulated positives.
hypotheses.rule: Any temporal-compatible world absent from the static-compatible set refutes T2.

hypotheses.claim: At least one frozen stochastic run has a strictly smaller temporal-compatible set than its unordered accumulated-positive compatible set.
hypotheses.rule: No strict gain anywhere refutes T3.

hypotheses.claim: The 8 static support-equivalence classes of size four are refined into more than 8 structural temporal-signature classes when earliest arrival is retained.
hypotheses.rule: Eight or fewer temporal-signature classes refute T4.

hypotheses.claim: At least one pair of static-support-equivalent M worlds is empirically separated by an observed early positive occurrence in at least one frozen stochastic run.
hypotheses.rule: Zero realised temporal separation of every static M-equivalent pair refutes T5.

hypotheses.claim: At least one horizon-40 stochastic run remains non-identifiable after temporal positive evidence.
hypotheses.rule: Unique recovery in all eligible horizon-40 runs refutes T6.

boundaries: The protocol is a successor motivated by the frozen S7 refutation; it does not retroactively change S7.
Observed late arrival cannot falsify a faster world.
Only an occurrence earlier than a candidate's minimum possible arrival is a temporal positive witness.
No non-detection or extinction time is used as negative evidence.
Temporal compatibility remains conditional on the finite candidate universe.
